name: Game of Life
desc: Conway's B3/S23 automaton boiling edge-to-edge — gliders sail from planted Gosper guns, chaotic soups reseed the dying regions, living cells burn hot-to-cool by age with a fading ember-ghost trail of the recently dead.

density.doc: soup/reseed density — how packed the frame stays with life

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude of cells & bloom

scale.doc: cell size — higher = chunkier cells / coarser grid

hue.doc: base hue of the age ramp (plasma/neon)
